items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Billy Preston as the boy W.C. Handy... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I mentioned Nelson before.

ctx.x: Right. And it also features Pearl Bailey, Cab Calloway, Mahalia Jackson, Ella Fitzgerald, Barney Bigard, Teddy Buckner, Red Callender, Curtis Counce, Lee Young, and Billy Preston as the boy W.C. Handy, music arranged and conducted by Nelson Riddle.
